Path: none

## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A5` · p2 · 2026-11-15T18:49Z

⛔ Not a claim.

A webhook subscription saved with `method: 'GET'` can never deliver, because every delivery carries the event body. On main it fails silently until the delivery dies; after PR #34067 it fails loudly at enqueue, but still never arrives. Customers can save a subscription that will never deliver, so **p2**. Recommended shape: refuse GET or HEAD at save time (the smallest honest contract), unless the seat finds a real need for query-string delivery. A5.

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Maintainer ruling recorded · #34098 · 2026-11-15T22:08Z

The maintainer tapped 「A 从契约中移除 GET」 on the decision card 「决定如何处理永远送不出去的 GET 方法 Webhook 订阅」 (2026-11-15T22:08Z, project thread), after the seat's independent Fable review (`/mnt/project-files/server-seat-5/fable-review-batch-1115d.md`, verdict SEND-WITH-EDITS).

Option text as tapped: spec 枚举和 sys_webhook 下拉都去掉 GET，属破坏性变更；已存的 GET 行停用并写明原因，不自动改成 POST。

The build:
- Remove `GET` from both surfaces: the spec `WebhookSchema` method enum (`packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts:196`) and the `sys_webhook` select (`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts:171`), with the generated `options.get` translations in every locale and `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx:175`. HEAD was never in either; leave it.
- Stored GET rows: park them through the existing `parkedReason` path (`auto-enqueuer.ts` ~L1255, #8069), which writes a visible terminal row with a reason. ⛔ Never auto-convert to POST: those rows never delivered, and a conversion would send POSTs to an endpoint configured for GET.
- `!`, a BREAKING banner, an ADR-0087 marker with a D3 migration note (no lossless conversion exists), the dogfood battery, and an L2 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review (spec schema face).
- Sequenced after PR #34067 (#33895), which makes the outbox refuse a GET with a body at enqueue.

Prior rulings read: docs/adr has no webhook × GET/method ruling; ADR-0012 and ADR-0018 (outbox substrate); ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove) and ADR-0078 (no silently inert metadata) point at A; #33895 / PR #34067 (outbox level only, consistent with A).
